notes.title: WyrmBound is live in Early Access!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that WyrmBound is finally released. The game is still early in development thus why it released in Early Access. I'm a solo developer.

I'm excited to see where this is going as well. I'm working on a few updates as we speak. Hopefully the game will get some sort of attention that will keep me pushing content. 

I'd love do hear your opinion about the game as well so make sure you check out the discord server.

notes.title: Demo content reduced, few UI adjustments
notes.notes:
As I'm pushing for Early Access release next week, I had to regulate the content in the demo. This update is only for the demo for now. 

I added few UI improvements as well.

notes.title: 1000 Wishlists milestone has been reached!
notes.notes:
Words cannot describe the feeling :)

Since I grew up, I always dreamed of having my own creation published on Steam. I'm very very close of it finally happening. 

I aim for an Early Access release on Steam with WyrmBound around late March this year. Hopefully I can improve the game as much as I can till then. 

I'm waiting everyone to join my discord server where I post updates about the game and where I answer questions and so on. 
[url=https://discord.com/invite/n3w5Qjxa4M]Discord - WyrmBound[/url]

notes.title: Fixed multiple issues for the demo
notes.notes:
Improved the support for controllers.
Fixed an issue where the second dragon couldn't be mounted.
Fixed the tutorials icons.

notes.title: WyrmBound
notes.notes: In WyrmBound, you can have thrilling fights to improve your skills, ride amazing dragons, control their abilities, and change the course of battles. Face off against legendary Asian deities and mythical creatures to bring back peace to the land.
